Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent misidentified the APOD city lights as Duluth and then made a speculative, incorrect linkage to Chicago’s John Hancock Center via Hancock, Michigan. This compounded error stemmed from failing to verify the APOD’s actual city (Marquette) and its namesake’s Chicago landmark (the Marquette Building, designed by Holabird & Roche), leading to the wrong firm (“Skidmore”) instead of the correct “Holabird.”
